t: You are standing where Earls Court Exhibition Centre used to be. It was a major international exhibition and events venue, and it is said to have brought in two billion pounds a year at its peak. The art moderne building went up between 1935 and 1937, on grounds that had held exhibitions and entertainments since 1887. Its architect was the American C. Howard Crane, who mostly worked in Detroit, where he designed the Fox Theatre and Olympia Stadium. A proposal to list the building was refused after developers bought it, and demolition was finished in 2017.
